name: depth-carousel
title: Depth Carousel
description: A carousel of photography cards arranged on a 3D rail: the leading image is sharp while the rest shrink, blur and darken behind it. Drag, scroll, click, use the arrows, the dots or the arrow keys to move.
use: A gallery or portfolio where photos should feel like physical objects on a rail, not a flat strip.
avoid: It needs a tall container, hides most slides behind blur, and captures the mouse wheel from the page.
a11y: Arrow keys step the carousel, controls are labelled buttons, and slides carry alt text and counts. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: One large rounded photo sits centred on a black stage, with two or three more cards stepped behind it to the right, each smaller and hazier. Small round arrow buttons flank the stage and a row of tiny dots rests at the bottom centre.
behaves: Cards glide along the rail with a springy ease, the new front image sharpening as the old ones sink back. Dragging follows the pointer and flicks to the nearest card; scrolling, clicking a card, the arrows and the dot row all advance it.
customise: Pass an items array of image URLs or image and alt objects. Card size, depth, spread, tilt, blur, tint, autoplay, loop, controls and indicators are all props.
weight: moderate: Six image cards animated with GSAP transforms and blur filters; idle once settled.
